facts.fact: The Calabash reports that, after the Sierra Leone Police handed 39 laptops to Local Unit Commanders for electronic correspondence, traditional stationery would be kept mainly for operational work such as statement-taking and physical record-keeping; the handover is undated, so the article's published date is used.
facts.system: statement-taking and physical record-keeping on stationery

systems.system: laptop computers for Local Unit Commanders, for electronic official correspondence
systems.tiers: 39 laptops to Local Unit Commanders (divisional commanders) across the country; connection to the national fibre optic network being arranged, not yet made

systems.system: statement-taking and physical record-keeping on stationery

note: The laptops are for administrative correspondence between headquarters and divisional commands, under Goal Four, Intervention Five of the Strategic Development Plan 2025-2029; the article names no system in which reports or cases are entered.
